description: This file provides helper functions for managing storage records, including creation, deletion, opening, writing patterns, and validation, primarily used in testing scenarios within the starboard namespace.

methods.name: ClearStorageRecord
methods.description: Deletes the current storage record, with optional name parameter for named record deletion.

methods.name: OpenStorageRecord
methods.description: Opens a storage record, validating its correctness, with optional name parameter for named record.

methods.name: WriteStorageRecord
methods.description: Writes a pattern of bytes into an open storage record.

methods.name: InitializeStorageRecord
methods.description: Initializes storage with a standard pattern of bytes for a given length.

methods.name: CheckStorageBuffer
methods.description: Checks a buffer for the expected pattern at specified offsets.

methods.name: ReadAndCheckStorage
methods.description: Reads from a storage record into a buffer and verifies the pattern.
